title: Japanese Fun - J64
description:
Master Japanese scripts effortlessly and enjoyably! Japanese Fun - J64, the first app built on the innovative Space64 learning platform, now offers an enriched learning experience with features like Kanji basics, testing mode, achievements, daily streaks, and leaderboards. Whether you're learning Hiragana, Katakana, or beginner Kanji, each lesson is designed to be interactive and rewarding!

Key Features:

Play & Learn: Dive into more mini-games! Enjoy Kana Eater, Karaoke, Puzzles, Match 3, and Memory—with modes for matching Hiragana and Katakana to strengthen script connections.

Teacher Simulator: Step into the role of a Japanese-language teacher in this special mini-game! Teach your virtual student Japanese concepts, respond to questions, and see how your teaching impacts their progress.

Achievements: Track your learning progress by completing milestones and achievements. Earn EXP to measure your progress and stay motivated.

Fun Japanese Words: Explore essential Japanese words organized by themes to grow your vocabulary in an enjoyable, contextual way.

Smart Review: Our intelligent algorithm highlights kana and words you need more practice with, ensuring efficient learning.

Kana & Kanji Lessons: Begin with easy-to-follow kana lessons, then explore basic Kanji characters, building a solid foundation in Japanese writing systems.

Writing Practice: Practice writing each kana and Kanji character for a hands-on, immersive experience.

Testing Mode: Assess your knowledge and track your improvement through regular tests.

Daily Streaks & Leaderboards: Stay motivated and compete with friends through daily streaks and leaderboards.

Reference Table: Access a complete kana and Kanji table with native pronunciations for every character.

Flexible Learning: Set your own learning path with no rigid progression. Learn in a way that suits your style.

Multiple Voices: Choose from various Japanese text-to-speech voices for authentic pronunciation.

Localized Content: The app is available in 20 languages, making learning accessible to a global audience.

Completely Offline: Learn anywhere, anytime—no internet required.

No Account Required: Start learning immediately without needing an account.

Multiple Learning Profiles: Set up personalized profiles for family or friends.

Download Japanese Fun - J64 now and be among the first to experience the Space64 platform. Start mastering Japanese kana, Kanji, and essential words—your way!
description_short: Learn Japanese kana & Kanji with fun games, achievements, and writing practice!
